newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Nov Treasury deficit $955 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Nov Treasury deficit $955 mln.

text.p: Argentina had a Treasury deficit in November of $955 million versus $930.4 million in the same month last year, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
The Treasury figure, which includes spending by state agencies, showed total Treasury income for November of $1.21 billion versus total spending of $2.16 billion.
Revenues were $26.2 million lower than a year earlier and spending was $1.6 million lower.
Current revenue for the month was $1.18 billion versus current spending of $2.1 billion.
Capital revenues, which were zero a year earlier, totalled $30 million -- $7.7 million from privatizations -- while capital expenditure $66.5 million, an increase of $21.2 million on a year earlier.
